correctness.rationale: For explicit eleven-vertex eighteen-edge Herschel graph, the Alexander dual K has full edge skeleton, 42 connected triples and nine square tetrahedra; no five-face exists. Independently constructed those 11,55,42,9 cells and exact signed boundary matrices with rational ranks (10,32,9), giving dual H1 rank13 and H2 rank1. Ranks over F2,F3,F5,F7 all match; an explicit 18-triangle two-cycle has integral boundary zero, and adjoining it to d3 raises rank mod3 from9 to10. Enumerated all 12 graph automorphisms and calculated signed Lefschetz traces and the induced dual H2 action modulo3. With Alexander duality orientation twist, independently recovered all six stated (H6,H7) traces: (1,13),(1,-5),(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,1),(-1,-1). Integral homology and nonshellability are additionally implied by older published stronger wedge-homotopy theorem, not just modular tests. No equivariant homotopy classification is asserted.
